long_description:
Sunoh.ai is an AI-powered ambient medical scribe designed to automate clinical documentation for physicians and healthcare providers. The platform uses natural language processing to listen to patient-provider conversations and generate structured clinical notes, reducing documentation burden.

Sunoh has achieved significant market penetration with over 100,000 providers using the platform. A key differentiator is the platform's multi-language support, enabling providers to conduct visits and generate notes in multiple languages—particularly valuable for practices serving diverse patient populations.

The company has formed a strategic partnership with eClinicalWorks, one of the largest ambulatory EHR vendors, providing deep integration capabilities for practices using that system. Sunoh also integrates with other major EHR platforms.

At $149 per month, Sunoh positions itself as an affordable alternative to enterprise AI scribe solutions. The pricing makes AI documentation accessible to solo practitioners and small practices that may not qualify for or afford enterprise-level AI scribe products. The platform is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 certified.
